name: Matthew J. Skahill
service_line_reviewed: Service reviewed: Appointed March 9, 2021 through September 13, 2026. Selected decisions: 1.

biography.text: Skahill earned a B.A. from the College of the Holy Cross (2001) and a J.D. from the University of Connecticut School of Law (2004). Before appointment he served as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in New Jersey, handling a broad criminal docket. His current chambers are in Camden.
